scope: West 23rd Street hotel exterior, red brick, iron balconies, pointed gables and rooftop massing.

sources.publisher: New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission
sources.title: Hotel Chelsea designation report
facts: The eleven-storey brick street elevation has successive iron galleries with vegetation ornament and tall doors.
A raised central portion carries a steep slate pyramid between large brick chimney stacks.
Both projecting end wings terminate in masonry gables with tall pointed openings.
sources.inspection: Complete one-page primary description read. Its factual architecture supplements the WPA balcony photograph; no city photograph or illustration is reproduced.

limits: Historic landmark description is not a measured survey or proof of unchanged modern roof services.
Exact pitches, upper window dimensions, hidden rear details, small shopfronts and decorative profiles remain bounded medium-fi approximations.
referenceDecision: The earlier whole-exterior photograph requirement was broader than the medium-fi brief. Partial but relevant public-domain photographs plus independent primary architecture and map controls establish the full defining silhouette. No original geometry scope removed.
